name: Oyako Ai 2
source: Mizumori Kazuki discovers his mother's secret desire. Unable to hold himself back once he knows the truth Kazuki crosses the forbidden line and becomes his own mother's lover. Now the couple wishes to seal their immoral bond by creating a baby together.
